title: Report a missing item
summary: Ruby on Rails: Report a missing item. Inspect status 404.
introduction: Rails status symbols name HTTP statuses. Open GET /missing. Read the example, then check the result.
learningObjectives: Report a missing item with Ruby on Rails

blocks.text: Create a practice project with rails new school --api --skip-active-record. Enter it. Put each labelled section into its named file, then run bin/rails server -b 127.0.0.1 -p 8000. No database is needed.

blocks.title: Report a missing item
blocks.code:
# config/routes.rb
Rails.application.routes.draw do
get "/missing", to: "lesson#missing"
end

# app/controllers/lesson_controller.rb
class LessonController < ActionController::API
def missing
 render json: { error: "Book not found" }, status: :not_found
end
end

blocks.text: The :not_found symbol chooses HTTP 404 along with the error hash.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: An error body should come with an error status.
